and 5&prime;-CCGTAA-3&prime;.</p><p>But the first PCR run contained significant contamination due to mispriming. Probably from using too short of primers that were only 6 nucleotide in length.</p><p>Choose the correct pair of RNA primers that will amplify the remaining region of DNA inside the old primers using <strong>nested PCR</strong>. The nested RNA primers are 6 bases in length.</p><p>Pay close attention to the 5&prime; and 3&prime; ends of the primers.</p>	<!-- CAGCGU --> &nbsp;<table style="border-collapse: collapse; border: 1px solid #999; The nested RNA primers are 6 bases in length.</p><p>Pay close attention to the 5&prime; and 3&prime; ends of the primers.</p>	<!-- UCAGAU --> &nbsp;<table style="border-collapse: collapse; border: 1px solid #999;
